caption: The drawing consists of three distinct elements arranged on a plain, light-colored background. At the top is a depiction of an eagle with outstretched wings. The eagle's feathers are rendered in shades of brown, yellow, and gold, with detailed patterns on the wings and body, and its eye is red with a white outline. The bird's beak is hooked and dark brown, with its mouth open, showing a red interior. Below the main eagle figure, to the left, there is a detailed drawing of an eagle's head in profile, colored similarly in brown tones, with a red eye and open beak displaying a pinkish-red interior. On the right side below the main eagle, there is a cluster of brown and tan feathers, represented as a small bunch. The three objects are spatially separated and presented against an unadorned background.
title: Gilt Eagle
